content_of_post_to_comment: I’ve always wanted to write, and after many years of procrastination, I have finally finished my book on common herbs... I know, I know, you're saying it's about thyme.
comment: The thyme joke aside, there’s an interesting gap between wanting to write and finishing: the book becomes a record not just of herbs, but of years of accumulated attention. I wonder how much of the craft came from the waiting itself.
